suite: V2.5.1 — Android Billing Recovery Hardening & Build Readiness
note: V2.5.1 adds 13 new suites on top of V2.5.0's 163: consume-after-credit ordering (consumePurchase moved after creditPack to preserve queryPurchases recovery path), creditResult.ok gate on consumption, initAutoRecovery duplicate-init guard (AUTO_RECOVERY_INIT), polling bounds and cleanup, TWA checkout does not fall back to PayPal, restore credits only FULFILLED entries, server claim/fulfill idempotent replay verification, creditPack rejection of unverified attempts, deterministic fulfillmentId from orderId, env var name consistency (GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY), non-consumable never consumed, no secrets in error messages. Android build blocked by dl.google.com proxy restriction.
